title: Determining The Structure and Binding Properties of DPS – A Nucleoid Associated Protein
content: Bacterial cells are often exposed to a varied range of environmental conditions, thus often requiring rapid mechanisms to enable a suitable response to these external threats. Here we study a protein from Escherichia coli, namely ‘DNA protection during starvation’ (DPS). Functioning to protect DNA during starvation and acidic stress, DPS is strongly associated within the pathogenic life cycle of E. coli, and thus a worthy candidate of study within biomedical science [1,2,3].
